description: Read the SET of languages a brand publishes in — one brand can now publish in more than one language, each with its own keyword research, blog, and landing pages. Returns { defaultLanguage, languages, maxAllowed }. `defaultLanguage` sits at the domain root with no URL prefix; every other enabled language sits under /{languageCode} (e.g. /cs). `languages` always lists the default first. `maxAllowed` is how many languages this brand's plan allows — Trial/Growth 1, Pro 2, Enterprise 5. This is distinct from get_brand_content_language, which reports only the single default language (feature 104, still the source of truth for `defaultLanguage`). Use this tool when you need the FULL enabled set.
name: get_brand_languages
